# Feroxi
The Feroxi (fer-ox-i) are a race of humanoid shark-like beings. Carnivourous in nature with a strong bite force.
## Diet
- Can ONLY eat meat.
## Benefits
- Uses their jaws to do [color=#ec3a3a]Piercing[/color] damage, and harder than other species, rivaling Oni. - Their cartilaginous skeleton allows them to take [color=#1e90ff]10% less Blunt damage.[/color] - Their adaptation to native environments allows them to take [color=#1e90ff]10% less cold damage.[/color] - Their biology allows them to breathe water vapour.
## Drawbacks
- They take [color=#FFA500]10% more Slash damage.[/color] - Gets [color=#FFA500]thirsty 100% faster[/color]. - When thirst falls to "Parched," they begin to [color=#FFA500]suffocate.[/color] Have water handy! - Saline is too salty! It hydrates you much less! - Your lungs are non-removable, as they're integrated with your gills.
## Feroxi Naming Conventions
Feroxi in the galactic stage have adopted a naming scheme similar to Humans, but often with a focus on names more referential figures of mythological or oceanic significance. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Ishmael Alawi - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Hikuwai Caldera - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Caspian Cassius - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Tai York - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Jaws - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] King Shark
## Lore
The Feroxi, originating from the origin world of Ferox, are well known throughout the universe as the ancient enemies of the Carp species. For many Feroxi they find employment specifically in fields where the slaughter of Carp is commonplace, and the possible slaughter of a Space Dragon is a welcome possability. This behavior has not extended by most Feroxi to the Thaven species, however. Whether this is due to the Thaven's unique psychology, their ability to communicate, or simply a lack of violence between the two species is something heavily debated by anthropologists and historians alike.
